gloss: former years; olden days; years past

definitions.gloss: former years; olden days; years past
definitions.explanation: A literary and formal term referring to times long gone by. Used to evoke a sense of nostalgia or historical distance, typically in written or formal spoken contexts.

examples.japanese: {昔年|せきねん}の{面影|おもかげ}が{残|のこ}っている。
{昔年|せきねん}の{恩|おん}を{忘|わす}れることはない。
examples.english: I will never forget the kindness shown to me in years past.

examples.japanese: {昔年|せきねん}の{栄華|えいが}を{偲|しの}ばせる{城跡|しろあと}が、{静|しず}かに{丘|おか}の{上|うえ}に{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: The castle ruins, evoking the splendor of bygone years, stood quietly atop the hill.

notes:
Composed of {昔|せき} (past, former — the on'yomi of {昔|むかし}) and {年|ねん} (year). A literary and formal word that is used almost exclusively in written language, speeches, and formal essays. In everyday conversation, {昔|むかし} or {以前|いぜん} would be used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昔年|せきねん}の{友|とも}: a friend from years past
- {昔年|せきねん}の{記憶|きおく}: memories of former years
- {昔年|せきねん}を{懐|なつ}かしむ: to look back fondly on past years

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {昔|むかし}: long ago — the everyday word for the past
- {往年|おうねん}: past years — also literary but more commonly seen, especially in {往年|おうねん}の (of former days)
- {旧年|きゅうねん}: last year; the old year — specifically the previous year, often used at New Year
